## 更新内容

### 任务栏歌词

- 设置页「实验」分区新增“任务栏翻译独立滚动”开关，默认关闭。
- 开启后，任务栏歌词与翻译各按自身长度滚动：放得下的一行保持不动（右对齐时贴右），超长的一行单独滚动。左对齐和右对齐样式均生效。
- 关闭时保持原有同步滚动：两行共用较长一行的宽度，一起滚动。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.6.0.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.6.0.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。

- Release 构建 0 警告 0 错误；逻辑及服务测试（Release）：361/361 通过。
- 任务栏控件测试（Release）：58/58 通过，新增独立滚动测试；v1.5.3 中超时的桌面歌词快捷菜单测试已修复。
- 设置卡片样式与实机任务栏上的滚动效果尚未目视确认。

## Changes in English

### Taskbar lyrics

- Added an experimental "Scroll taskbar translation independently" option in Settings, off by default.
- When enabled, the taskbar lyric and its translation each scroll by their own length: a line that fits stays still (flush right in the right-aligned style), and an overflowing line scrolls on its own. It applies to both left- and right-aligned styles.
- When disabled, the lines keep scrolling in step, sharing the width of the longer line.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.6.0.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly.

The Release build had no warnings or errors. All 361 logic/service tests and all 58 taskbar widget tests passed, including the new independent-scrolling test; the desktop lyrics quick-menu test that timed out in v1.5.3 is fixed. The settings card and the scrolling on a live taskbar have not been checked visually.

Full changelog: [v1.5.3...v1.6.0](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.5.3...v1.6.0)
